# Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(randomForest)
library(ranger)
library(caret)
library(performance)
```

# Load data
```{r}
source("_config.r")

# Load preprocessed moss model data (slopes + climate features + static env, one row per plot)
moss_data <- readRDS(PATH_MDL2_MOSS_DATA)
```

# Data preparation
## Check dimensions and remove incomplete rows
```{r}
dim(moss_data) # 1438 x 187
View(moss_data)
```

# Species change modelling
## Train test split
```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_idx         <- caret::createDataPartition(moss_data$total_change_pct, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
moss_change_train <- moss_data[ train_idx, ]
moss_change_test  <- moss_data[-train_idx, ]
```

## Hyperparameter tuning, mtry and min.node.size
```{r}
train_control <- caret::trainControl(
  method          = "repeatedcv",
  number          = 5,
  repeats         = 10,
  savePredictions = "final",
  returnResamp    = "all"
)

moss_change_grid <- base::expand.grid(
  mtry          = c(10, 20, floor(ncol(moss_change_train) / 3), floor(ncol(moss_change_train) * 0.75), ncol(moss_change_train) - 1),
  splitrule     = "variance",
  min.node.size = c(3, 5, 7, 10)
)

rf_moss_change_tune <- caret::train(
  total_change_pct ~ .,
  set.seed(123),
  method      = "ranger",
  importance  = "none",
  data        = moss_change_train,
  num.trees   = 500,
  trControl   = train_control,
  tuneGrid    = moss_change_grid,
  na.action   = na.omit,
  num.threads = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  verbose     = TRUE
)

saveRDS(rf_moss_change_tune, file = file.path(DIR_MDL2_OUT, "rf_moss_change_tune.rds"))
write.csv(rf_moss_change_tune$results, file = file.path(DIR_MDL2_OUT, "rf_moss_change_tune_ranking.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Fit final model with best hyperparameters
```{r}
best_mtry      <- rf_moss_change_tune$bestTune$mtry
best_nodesize  <- rf_moss_change_tune$bestTune$min.node.size

rf_moss_change <- ranger::ranger(
  total_change_pct ~ .,
  data          = moss_change_train,
  num.trees     = 500,
  mtry          = best_mtry,
  min.node.size = best_nodesize,
  splitrule     = "variance",
  importance    = "permutation",
  num.threads   = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  seed          = 123
)

rf_moss_change

# Save the model
saveRDS(rf_moss_change, file = file.path(DIR_MDL2_OUT, "rf_moss_change.rds"))
```

### Evaluate on test data
```{r}
# Predict on test data
rf_moss_change_test_pred <- predict(rf_moss_change, data = moss_change_test)

# Calculate performance metrics
r2_moss_change  <- 1 - sum((rf_moss_change_test_pred$predictions - moss_change_test$total_change_pct)^2) /
                       sum((moss_change_test$total_change_pct - mean(moss_change_test$total_change_pct))^2)
mse_moss_change <- mean((rf_moss_change_test_pred$predictions - moss_change_test$total_change_pct)^2)

r2_moss_change
mse_moss_change
```

## Fit model using cv
```{r}
rf_moss_change_full_cv <- caret::train(
  total_change_pct ~ .,
  data        = moss_data,
  method      = "ranger",
  importance  = "none",
  num.trees   = 500,
  trControl   = train_control,
  tuneGrid    = expand.grid(
    mtry          = floor(ncol(moss_data) / 3),
    splitrule     = "variance",
    min.node.size = 5
  ),
  na.action   = na.omit,
  num.threads = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  verbose     = TRUE,
  seed = 123,
)

rf_moss_change_full_cv

resamp <- rf_moss_change_full_cv$resample
data.frame(
  metric = c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE"),
  mean   = colMeans(resamp[, c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE")], na.rm = TRUE),
  sd     = apply(resamp[, c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE")], 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
)

#           metric       mean         sd
#RMSE         RMSE 97.5462433 6.83410139
#Rsquared Rsquared  0.1257051 0.04390845
#MAE           MAE 64.1007917 3.65302872

# Save the cv model and results
saveRDS(rf_moss_change_full_cv, file = file.path(DIR_MDL2_OUT, "rf_moss_change_full_cv.rds"))
write.csv(rf_moss_change_full_cv$results, file = file.path(DIR_MDL2_OUT, "rf_moss_change_full_cv_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
